title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Copilot Credits usage report for pay-as-you-go in Copilot Chat
summary: Hold: the briefing incorrectly says the Cost Management API supports delegated permissions only. Microsoft's current reference also lists application permissions. The report's main capabilities and rollout information are supported, with minor corrections needed to the report navigation, concealment call format and rollout wording.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents no API for the dedicated Copilot Chat Credits report as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: "Copilot Credits report" "API". Opened Credits report and Cost Management usage reports overview; results also described Power Platform usage exports, not an API for this dedicated Copilot Chat report.

claims.claim: Name concealment is configured at Settings > Org settings > Services > Reports > Conceal user, group, and site names in all reports.
claims.quote:
Select Org Settings.
4. On the Services tab, select Reports.
5. In the Reports panel, uncheck the checkbox next to Conceal user, group, and site names in all reports.

claims.claim: PATCH /beta/admin/reportSettings with displayConcealedNames set to true updates tenant-wide report concealment.
claims.fix: Set controls[1].api.call and the rendered call to 'PATCH /beta/admin/reportSettings'. Replace its note with 'Beta API, not supported for production applications. The request body sets displayConcealedNames: true conceals user, group and site names; false shows them.'

claims.claim: Setting displayConcealedNames to true conceals identifying information in reports.
claims.quote: If set to true, all reports conceal user information such as usernames, groups, and sites.

claims.claim: Setting displayConcealedNames to false displays identifying information in reports.
claims.quote: If false, all reports show identifiable information.

claims.claim: The concealment endpoint is beta and not supported for production applications.
claims.quote: APIs under the /beta version in Microsoft Graph are subject to change. Use of these APIs in production applications is not supported.

claims.claim: GET /beta/copilot/costManagement/usageReports/userUsageRecords?startDate={startDate}&endDate={endDate} retrieves per-user credit consumption.
claims.quote: GET https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/costManagement/usageReports/userUsageRecords?startDate=2026-07-01&endDate=2026-07-02&$orderby=consumedQuantity desc&$top=2&$count=true

claims.claim: The userUsageRecords call requires exactly one completed UTC day.
claims.quote: The range must select exactly one completed UTC day. Current-day, future, and multi-day ranges are rejected, not clamped.

claims.where: controls[2].note; Governance controls table and final paragraph
claims.claim: The userUsageRecords API supports delegated work or school permissions only.
claims.quote: | Application | CopilotCostManagement-UserData.Read.All | CopilotCostManagement.Read.All |
claims.fix: In controls[2].note and the rendered note, replace 'delegated permissions only' with 'delegated work or school and application permissions in the Graph permission model, subject to deployment availability and authorization'. In the final Governance controls paragraph, replace 'supports delegated work or school permissions only' with 'lists delegated work or school and application permissions in the Graph permission model, subject to deployment availability and authorization'. The cited operation's Permissions section and https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/copilot/extensibility/api/admin-settings/cost-management/overview#permission-availability-and-authorization give these qualifications.

claims.claim: The Cost Management userUsageRecords API is beta.
claims.quote: APIs under the /beta version are subject to change. Use of these APIs in production applications is not supported.

claims.claim: The userUsageRecords call is not an equivalent for every Consumption tab breakdown or the dedicated Credits report.
claims.quote: Get a list of costManagementUserUsageRecord objects that report each user's consumption of Copilot Credits for one completed UTC day, ranked by consumption.

claims.claim: The report's tenant-wide concealment setting also affects Billing Policy ID.
claims.quote: Changes to this hidden data setting affect the username, display name, and Billing Policy ID.

claims.claim: No additional report-specific administrative configuration is documented beyond report access and name concealment as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: "Copilot Credits report" "settings"; "Copilot Credits report" "disable" "configuration". Read Credits report and usage reports overview; found access roles and concealment, not another report-specific administrative setting.

claims.claim: A licensing entitlement specifically covering access to the Credits report is not published.
claims.quote: Searched: "Copilot Credits report" "license"; Microsoft 365 admin center usage reports license requirements reports reader license. Read Credits report, usage reports overview, pay-as-you-go setup and service overview; no report licence entitlement stated.
